Now write the following. Return only the requested text.
Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

September update

We finished the migration off the old queue service this month. Every worker now runs on the new job-runner, and we retired the legacy `queue-worker` container on the 28th. Error rates dropped by half in the first week, mostly because the new system retries failed jobs instead of dropping them.

Two people joined the team: Priya Nair starts October 1st on the platform side, and Marcus Webb joined last week and is already working through the onboarding backlog with the infra pair.

The reporting-API rewrite slipped. We'd targeted August 29th; it's now due September 19th. The delay came from the migration eating more review time than planned, plus a schema change from the data team that landed mid-sprint and forced us to redo the aggregation layer. The core logic is done. What's left is test coverage and a pass on the slow endpoints.

For September: finish the reporting API, get Priya and Marcus fully ramped, and start scoping the notifications work we pushed from this quarter. If the schema stays stable, the API deadline should hold this time.

Thanks for the patience on the slip. Questions welcome anytime.
